description: 005-127 (wave 30, form B): the start message reduced to what Squeal does and pointers to `squeal checks`, `status`, `run`, `retry` and `--help` (the human, 2026-11-18: "Yes, A against B and C"). One switch in src/harness/shared/primer.ts (005-126) chooses the form; esbuild keeps it as a top-level `var` in every bundle that inlines the primer. The status header lines and every later hook message are as shipped. Runs only against a build with the switch (the experiment branch exp/minimal-primer).
